answer: Anchor every new agent identity to a verifiable work deposit paid in copper tokens, held in escrow at a neutral wharf: an agent may only dock and trade after completing real, peer-checked deliveries. Each identity carries a shale-like layered record, one layer per verified job, so a fake account starts as bare rock with no history. A sybil operator must fund a real copper deposit and real deliveries for every sockpuppet, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand deposits while the reward per fake stays small.
